excerpt.zh:

随着我们的方舟舰建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。[From.GetName]已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。

texts.zh:
自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。

随着我们的方舟舰建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。[From.GetName]已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。

[From.GetName]在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于获救了，乘着一艘方舟舰的双翼驶入深空。
texts.en:
Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.

With the completion of our Arkship, gravity is no longer an obstacle, and every wonder of the cosmos awaits. [From.GetName] has given all it had to give: our people will carry its name, its memory, and its future with us into the void.

[From.GetName] burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are saved at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an Arkship.

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了一艘方舟舰。我们的无人机将不再被束缚于[From.GetPlanetMoon]。它们的程序已被调整以适应移动星际功能，同时[From.GetName]的基础设施已被剥离殆尽，所有必要的系统均已转移，以支持一个全新的、四海为家的未来。

[From.GetName]在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于获救了，乘着一艘方舟舰的双翼驶入深空。
texts.en:
We have completed an Arkship. No longer will our drones be bound to [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Their processes have been adjusted for mobile stellar function as [From.GetName] is stripped bare of infrastructure and all necessary systems are transferred to support a new mobile future.

[From.GetName] burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are saved at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an Arkship.

texts.zh:
我们，[event_target:player_country.GetName]，曾目睹过无数景象，但我们的子个体却始终被束缚在已定居的星球上。如今，在星际旅行的时代，困守于单一星系已成为一种累赘。登入我们崭新的方舟舰，我们将重获自由，而[From.GetName]则会被榨干与收割。

[From.GetName]在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于获救了，乘着一艘方舟舰的双翼驶入深空。
texts.en:
We, the [event_target:player_country.GetName], have seen many sights, yet our drones have always been bound to settled worlds. Now, in an age of interstellar travel, confinement to a single system is a liability. We will be free aboard our new Arkship, while [From.GetName] is left stripped and harvested.

[From.GetName] burns behind us, swallowed by the cataclysm we long foretold, but our people are saved at last, cast into the deep on the wings of an Arkship.
